title: ENHANCING SELECTION OF CLIMATE TECH STARTUPS WITH AI: A CASE STUDY ON INTEGRATING HUMAN AND AI EVALUATIONS IN THE CLIMATECH GREAT GLOBAL INNOVATION CHALLENGE
